title: Global collaboRAtion on CIC-DUX4, BCOR-CCN3, High-grade Undifferentiated Round Cell Sarcoma (URCS) Project
official: Global collaboRAtion on CIC-DUX4, BCOR-CCN3, High-grade Undifferentiated Round Cell Sarcoma (URCS) Project
summary: Experimental study with biological material : case series review of clinical and histological data

interventions.name: data collection and analysis on Formalin-fixed paraffin embedded tissue and/or frozen tumoral tissue

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with undifferentiated round cell sarcomas treated from 01 January 1983 and all new patients will be included.
* Clinical and outcome information available.
* Histological slides/formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissue tumor blocks from archive available to perform the histology analysis/frozen tissue representative of the tumor available.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis different from undifferentiated round cell sarcomas
* Patient with no clinical or outcome information available
